0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Warriors visit the Lakers, and Golden State is still looking to get past last season, when it lost the series 1-3. Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody are out after knee surgery, and Kristaps Porzingis is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason and is a game-time decision. The Warriors' most recent meeting with the Lakers was a 119-103 loss in San Francisco on April 9, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Golden State a 35% chance to win.
